Definition: Shushan-Eduth or Shoshannim-Eduth, the title of a popular song
BiblicalUsage: Shushan-Eduth is the title of a song, not a place or a person, and it stands at the head of two psalms as the name of the tune they were sung to. The word never appears in a verse of Scripture, only in those two titles, where the singers would have known the melody it named.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the titles matter even when we have lost the tunes, because God heard the song even though we can no longer hum it.
